title: The browser build script packages the file it just built
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: The script that rebuilds the committed browser engine used to package a fixed path, so with a custom build directory it could pick up an older file. It now asks cargo where it built and which file it produced, and stops with a clear error if anything doesn't add up.
The committed browser files rebuild byte for byte with the default build directory and with a temporary one. Nothing about the engine itself changes.
